summary: Detects first-time engine-wear conditions for the vehicle matching the current player. Compares the current player vehicle's per-driver value at offset 18580 with that of the current vehicle; when they match, the wear parameter exceeds a threshold, and wear mode is active, notifies the driver once via sub_41B190. Stores the resulting present flag per driver and returns it.

compute vehicle pointer as vehicle array base plus 18624 times the vehicle index
if driver present flag byte_5EC354 indexed by driver id at vehicle offset 18580 is unset and condition holds, proceed to notify
notify driver via sub_41B190 with the vehicle pointer
store condition result into driver present flag byte_5EC354
